head: Gemini on CarPlay: Google's AI app now talks with you while you drive
dek: Google's Gemini app now works on Apple CarPlay, so you can have hands-free Gemini Live conversations in the car. It's rolling out worldwide from 11 November in every Gemini Live language.
details: Gemini was the last big AI chatbot without its own CarPlay app; ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Copilot, Meta AI and Grok already had one. Google suggests it for daily briefings, catching up on your inbox and brainstorming on the way.
where: iPhone with CarPlay, worldwide, rolling out
means: If you use Gemini, you can talk to it from your car's screen instead of picking up your phone.
todo: Update the Gemini app, allow the microphone and use Gemini Live once on your phone; then tap the Gemini icon on your CarPlay screen.
